validator.note: Official reference validator (Python, Apache-2.0). Pinned as the version anchor only; khai mirrors its ruleset in pure Node and does NOT run it. The npm package named 'skills-ref' is an unrelated third-party package, do not use it.

notes: Upstream publishes no semver tags or releases; the spec is a rolling main. We pin the validator's published version (clean semver) and the spec file's content hash. The on-touch drift check compares these against the real source. Re-pinning is a deliberate human act after reconciling the mirrored rules in lib/guard.mjs. Re-pinned 2026-08-28 from 494b0d84537c, after reconciling every rule the current spec states against lib/guard.mjs and finding the mirror faithful, and after confirming skills-ref is still 0.1.1 -- the pin already named that version, and a change to the RULES would ship as a validator release. So the hash moved on prose, not on contract. The reconciliation was rule-by-rule against the current text and not a diff, because this pin stores a hash and not the text: when it fires it can say that something moved and never what, which is why the advisory sat unread. Carrying the extracted rule table beside the hash would let a future drift answer 'prose only' by itself.
